description.value:
You cause a creature to temporarily lose its social and physical confidence, making it obliviously @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Clumsy]{Clumsy}. The targeted creature must attempt a Will save. A creature affected by this spell doesn't notice it is performing poorly and can't use reactions to reroll or improve the affected checks.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature is affected by awkwardness. It takes a –1 status penalty to attack rolls, Charisma-based skill checks, and Charisma-based saving throws. It also can't benefit from fortune effects on those rolls.

Critical Failure As failure, but the penalty increases to –2 and also applies to Dexterity-based saving throws.

Heightened (6th) On a failure, the penalty increases to –2 (and –3 on a critical failure). The spell no longer requires Sustain — it lasts for 1 minute without concentration.
